questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "rebounded" mean?
options: Closed at the same level as yesterday
questions.explain_en: Here "rebounded" means the index rose again after a previous drop.
questions.explain_zh: 在文中「rebounded」指的是指數在跌後再次上升。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX rebounds 2.50% to close above 39,000 after Wednesday's chip rout

questions.question: By how many points did the TAIEX increase on Thursday, Nov 26?
questions.explain_en: The summary says the index closed at 39,151.81, up about 956 points.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說指數收在 39,151.81 點，上漲約 956 點。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX rebounds 2.50% to close above 39,000 after Wednesday's chip rout

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "pivot" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "pivot" means the main point or focus that the market is revolving around.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「pivot」指的是市場的核心或焦點。
questions.news_title_en: AI chip stocks stay the market's pivot as TSMC slips even on rebound day

questions.question: According to the summary, how did TSMC's stock move on the rebound day?
questions.explain_en: The summary says TSMC edged about 0.2% lower even as the broader index bounced.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要指出，儘管大盤回升，台積電仍下跌約0.2%。
questions.news_title_en: AI chip stocks stay the market's pivot as TSMC slips even on rebound day

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "issuance" mean?
options: The process of creating and releasing something, such as a stablecoin
A method of measuring market volatility
The act of destroying a financial product
questions.explain_en: "Issuance" refers to the creation and distribution of a financial instrument, here a stablecoin.
questions.explain_zh: 「issuance」指的是創造並發行金融工具，在本文中是指穩定幣的發行。
questions.news_title_en: FSC advances stablecoin issuance rules limited to banks and bank-led ventures

questions.question: According to the summary, who is allowed to issue stablecoins under the new draft rules?
questions.explain_en: The draft rules limit stablecoin issuance to banks or ventures led by banks.
questions.explain_zh: 草案規定只有銀行或由銀行領導的事業體才能發行穩定幣。
questions.news_title_en: FSC advances stablecoin issuance rules limited to banks and bank-led ventures

questions.question: In the text, what does the phrase "high‑asset" mean?
options: Having a low amount of money
Having a large amount of money or wealth
questions.explain_en: "High‑asset" describes clients or programs that manage a large amount of assets, as shown by the trillions of NT$ mentioned.
questions.explain_zh: 「high‑asset」指的是資產規模很大的客戶或方案，文中提到的資產金額就說明了這點。
questions.news_title_en: High-asset AUM at banks tops NT$2 trillion, up more than 50% year-on-year

questions.question: According to the summary, how much did the assets managed by the 20 banks increase year‑on‑year?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the assets are up more than 50% year‑on‑year.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明資產較去年增長超過 50%。
questions.news_title_en: High-asset AUM at banks tops NT$2 trillion, up more than 50% year-on-year

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "exemption" mean?
options: A tax that must be paid
A reduction or removal of a tax requirement
questions.explain_en: An exemption is a reduction or removal of a tax that would otherwise be required.
questions.explain_zh: 「exemption」指的是免除或減免本應繳納的稅款。
questions.news_title_en: Estate and gift tax exemptions set to rise for 2027 as CPI crosses threshold

questions.question: According to the summary, when will Taiwan's estate‑tax exemption increase to about NT$14.78 million?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the increase is set for cases arising from 2027.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，遺產稅免稅額的提升將於 2027 年起生效。
questions.news_title_en: Estate and gift tax exemptions set to rise for 2027 as CPI crosses threshold

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "repatriation" mean?
options: Sending money back to its home country
questions.explain_en: Repatriation here means sending dividend money back to the investors' home country.
questions.explain_zh: 在文中，repatriation 指的是把股息金額匯回投資者的本國。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan's FX reserves slip below US$600 billion amid record equity outflows

questions.question: According to the summary, what happened to Taiwan's foreign‑exchange reserves?
options: They were unchanged from last year
They stayed exactly at US$600 billion
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the reserves have fallen below the US$600 billion mark.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，台灣的外匯儲備已跌破 600 億美元大關。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan's FX reserves slip below US$600 billion amid record equity outflows
